unsupported: The business traces its roots to the early 2000s when founder Kit Clark opened a shop in Bozeman, Montana, after studying furniture design at the Penland School of Crafts in North Carolina.
Each piece is built to order using traditional joinery and a selection of domestic and exotic woods chosen by the client.
Clark works alone or with minimal assistance, fabricating every component in-house and finishing each item to a museum-quality standard.
Output is measured in individual commissions rather than volume runs, with no published capacity figures.
The clientele consists primarily of residential customers across the continental United States and Canada, including homeowners and interior designers seeking one-of-a-kind heirloom pieces.
Shipping is arranged worldwide wherever freight can reach.

Known for: Lifetime guarantee on all pieces for as long as the original owner or family retains them; Ships throughout the continental U.S. and Canada (and worldwide where freight reaches); In-home design consultation for clients in the Maine area; Any gallery design can be reproduced in a variety of wood species; Award-winning craftsmanship recognized in the furniture industry
